title: Scanning Electron Microscopy and Correlated Techniques to Study Li-Ion Batteries
content: The most widely used batteries today and in the near future are Li-Ion based systems. Reliable characterization methods are the basis for improving battery properties and evaluating ageing phenomena. Our main objective is to create a database summarizing the results of the analytical investigation of ageing phenomena. In this database, damage patterns will be further correlated with electrochemical data. In this way, the usability of aged cells can be classified on the basis of electrochemical analysis.
